page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with notes in the left margin. The page number and running head stand at the top. No catchword or signature is printed.

main_text.p: gine Yamanenses ex Azdenfium familia, unde inunda-tione العرم sæpius memorata, migrare coacti, sedem ad aquam in Syria quæ غسان Gassan appellata est fixerunt, atque inde denominati sunt. Ante eos Syriam occupârunt Arabes الضجاعه AlDajaamii dicti, Salihenses, quibus illi fugatis, ac regibus eorum occisis succefserunt.
1 جفنة Jafnah f. Amri, f. Thaalaba, f. Amri, fil. Maxikia, cujus imperio, occisis Regibus Salihensibus, submiserunt se Arabes Kodaenses,&qui in Syria Damascena erant Graci, الروم
2 عمرو= Amrus Jafna filius: qui in Syria multa struxit {*}Monasteria veluti دير ايوب & دير برخالن & دير هند &Sen, vicos. عنة الدور
4 الحارث AlHareth, leu Aretas, Thaalaba filius.
7 المنذر الاكبر AlMondar AlAcbar, i.e. Maximus, Harethi filius.
12 جفنة الاصغر Jafnah alasgar, i.e. Minor, والمنذر الاكبر Al-Mondari Alacbari filius; Hic urbem Hiram incendit, inde ipsius posteri ال الحرق [?] i.e. Familia incendiarii dicti.
13 النعمان الاصغر AlNooman alAsgar, ipsius frater.
14 النعمان AlNooman, f. Amri, f. AlMondari, volunt

page.notes: Left margin note: "Sen, vicos." with an Arabic gloss, transcribed as far as legible; the gloss is uncertain. Arabic words throughout are copied from the scan and may contain letter-level errors; the Arabic in lines 2 and 12 is least certain. "ال الحرق" in item 12 is doubtful. Item 14 breaks off at "volunt" and continues on the next page. Printed "Asgar" in item 13 and "alasgar" in item 12 read as long s, transcribed as plain s.
